zh: 我忘记了账号的密码。
old_en: I forgot the password for my account.
new_en: I forgot the password for my account.

zh: 我试了好几次密码都不对。
old_en: I tried several times but the password didn't work.
new_en: I tried several times but the password didn't work.

zh: 我请他帮我设置新的登录方式。
old_en: I asked him to help me set up a new login method.
new_en: I asked him to help me set up a new login method.

zh: 我请同事帮我更改登录方式。
old_en: I asked my colleague to change my login method.
new_en: I asked my colleague to change my login method.

zh: 我问他怎么开启两步验证。
old_en: I asked him how to turn on two-step verification.
new_en: I asked him how to turn on two-step verification.

zh: 我问客服怎么设置两步验证。
old_en: I asked customer service how to set up two-step verification.
new_en: I asked customer service how to set up two-step verification.

zh: 我告诉他我的手机被锁了。
old_en: I told him my phone was locked.
new_en: I told him my phone was locked.

zh: 我跟他说我的手机打不开了。
old_en: I told him I couldn't open my phone.
new_en: I told him I couldn't open my phone.

zh: 我担心我的个人信息会被泄露。
old_en: I worry that my personal information might be leaked.
new_en: I worry that my personal information might be leaked.

zh: 我害怕我的密码会被别人知道。
old_en: I'm afraid that someone else might find out my password.
new_en: I'm afraid that someone else might find out my password.

zh: 我把隐私设置调整了不让陌生人看到。
old_en: I changed my privacy settings so strangers can't see anything.
new_en: I adjusted my privacy settings so strangers can't see anything.

zh: 我不让别人看到我的照片和信息。
old_en: I don't let others see my photos and information.
new_en: I don't let others see my photos and messages.

zh: 我收到一条可疑的链接不敢点击。
old_en: I got a suspicious link and didn't dare to click it.
new_en: I received a suspicious link and was afraid to click it.

zh: 我收到一个奇怪的邮件不敢打开。
old_en: I received a strange email and didn't dare to open it.
new_en: I got a strange email and didn't dare to open it.

zh: 我接到一个电话，被骗着转了钱。
old_en: I got a call and ended up sending money after being tricked.
new_en: I took a call and was tricked into transferring money.

zh: 对方让我把密码告诉他，我才发现被骗了。
old_en: They asked me to tell them my password, and then I realized I had been tricked.
new_en: They asked for my password, and then I realized I was scammed.

zh: 我打电话让银行冻结我的卡。
old_en: I called the bank to freeze my card.
new_en: I called the bank to freeze my card.

zh: 我给银行打电话让他们冻结我的银行卡。
old_en: I phoned the bank and asked them to freeze my credit card.
new_en: I called the bank to have them freeze my bank card.

zh: 我提醒妈妈小心网络诈骗。
old_en: I reminded my mom to be careful about online scams.
new_en: I reminded my mom to be careful of online scams.

zh: 我告诉爸爸要注意网络诈骗。
old_en: I told my dad to watch out for online scams.
new_en: I told my dad to watch out for online scams.
